items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was character called Christopher... [INTERVIEWEE] He mentions the "Philly Sound."

ctx.x: Me too. I just finished as a matter of fact and it's like — it's my second time without my wife to watch it. And what I do is I actually play the cello — I know the dialogue a lot now so I will play scales and I'll play, you know I'm like working on a few new pieces. My hands hurt. But I'm trying my best you know, with my time, you know I make myself work on music for three or four hours a day no matter what the day may entail like I did when I was little. I mean, you know,
